regularModeDesc: Answer questions to score points. You have 3 lives. The game ends when you run out of lives.
timeAttackModeDesc: Score as many points as you can in 60 seconds. There are no lives, so speed is key! Correct answers add 2 seconds, but wrong answers deduct 2 seconds.
aboutAppDescription: A fun and simple game designed to help young learners practice and improve their math skills in an engaging way.
builtWithLove: Built with ❤️ for young learners everywhere.
author: by Dieter Balmer
privacySummary: Your privacy is super important to us! Here’s a simple breakdown of how we handle your information:
privacyPoint1Desc: Your scores and leaderboard name are saved only in your browser's local storage. No data is ever sent to or stored on any online servers. Your information never leaves your device.
privacyPoint2Desc: We do not collect any personal information, analytics, or usage data. Your gameplay is completely private and anonymous.
privacyPoint3Desc: This app is designed to be a safe environment for everyone, especially kids. There are no external links, ads, or data sharing features.

multiplicationModeDesc: This mode has a special scoring system based on the difficulty of the times table (the first number). There is no difficulty multiplier.
multiplicationStreakDesc: Streak bonuses are added on top of these points.
